world.title: Ties with Asean crucial for India's Act East Policy: PM
world.summary: PM Modi is visiting The Philippines for two days to attend the India-Asean and East Asia Summit meetings. Upon arrival in Manila, he emphasized the importance of strengthening ties with ASEAN as a crucial element of India's Act East Policy. Modi expressed optimism that this visit would revitalize India's partnerships in the region, enhancing collaboration and mutual interests.

world.title: Paraguay ex-president moved to military jail amid special treatment reports
world.summary: Paraguay's former President Santiago Pena has been moved to a military prison by a judge's order amid allegations of corruption linked to the recent collapse of Ueno Bank. Reports indicated he received special treatment while awaiting trial. Judge Osmar Legal's decision aims to ensure equal treatment for all detainees in light of the ongoing financial scandal.

world.title: United Airlines Resolves Technology Issue After Widespread Outage
world.summary: United Airlines experienced a system outage lasting over 90 minutes on Monday, causing delays for departing flights. However, flights already in the air and those on the United Express regional network were unaffected. This incident followed a recent malfunction in the Federal Aviation Administration's network that led to a nationwide ground stop, highlighting ongoing technological challenges in air travel.

business.title: Tata Sons facing 'back-door takeover', warns Jimmy Tata
business.summary: Jimmy Tata, younger brother of Ratan Tata and trustee of the Sir Ratan Tata Trust, has expressed concerns about a potential "back-door takeover" of Tata Sons. He emphasized the need for transparency and proper governance within the organization. His remarks come amid ongoing discussions about the future leadership and direction of Tata Sons, highlighting internal family dynamics and trust issues.

business.title: IBM in talks for 2 large projects in India: CEO Krishna
business.summary: IBM is in discussions for two significant projects in India, following the Amravati Quantum Tech Park initiative. CEO Arvind Krishna noted that the company's annual investment of $3 billion in India could increase in the coming years. These developments highlight IBM's commitment to expanding its presence and capabilities within the Indian technology sector.

business.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
business.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Corma has achieved a $1 billion valuation just three months after launching its product. The company raised $125 million in a Series A funding round, led by NEA. Corma specializes in AI models and agents designed for cybersecurity defense, marking a significant milestone in its early development and positioning within the cybersecurity industry.

technology.title: XBOX Black Friday Sale Starts November 19 with Our Biggest Sale of the Year on Games, Accessories and More!
technology.summary: The XBOX Black Friday sale begins on November 19, offering significant discounts on games and accessories. Shoppers can save up to 80% on select XBOX and PC games, along with various discounts on XBOX accessories. The sale aims to provide an opportunity for gift-giving for gamers, including options like custom controllers with free engraving.

technology.title: Quordle hints and answers for Tuesday, November 17 (game #1758)
technology.summary: Quordle offers daily puzzles, with a new game released at midnight based on your time zone. Players may find themselves solving either the current day’s puzzle or the previous day’s. The article provides hints and answers for Quordle game #1758, along with access to past solutions for those seeking assistance with their gameplay.

technology.title: GTA 6 Gets New Screenshots Highlighting Leonida's Dynamic Weather
technology.summary: Rockstar has released new screenshots for GTA 6, featuring Leonida's dynamic weather system. Accompanying the visuals is a Weather Channel forecast, highlighting the game's immersive environment. As anticipation builds for the return to Vice City after a 13-year wait, the launch is imminent, with only days remaining until players can experience the updated gameplay and features.

sports.title: IND vs NZ: 'Rahul Dravid batted us into submission' - Kyle Mills recalls India's 2009 triumph in Hamilton Test | Exclusive Interview
sports.summary: In an exclusive interview, Kyle Mills reflected on India's 2009 Test victory in Hamilton, where Rahul Dravid's performance was pivotal. Mills noted that New Zealand has historically posed challenges for India, highlighting that it has been 17 years since India last secured a Test win on New Zealand soil. Gautam Gambhir contributed significantly with a score of 72.

sports.title: IPL Retention Day: Predicting who's retained, released for all 10 teams
sports.summary: IPL 2027 retention day is approaching, prompting all 10 franchises to make critical squad decisions before the December auction. Predictions indicate potential big-name exits, including players like Shami, Sam Curran, and Yashasvi Jaiswal. The current trade window has been active, resembling European football's summer transfer period, as teams prepare to finalize their rosters ahead of the upcoming season.

sports.title: Gerrard offers Pochettino advice on what to do with Bruno Fernandes at Old Trafford
sports.summary: Steven Gerrard has advised Mauricio Pochettino, the new Manchester United manager, on handling the situation regarding Bruno Fernandes. Following the dismissal of Michael Carrick, Pochettino is tasked with addressing the challenges surrounding Fernandes at Old Trafford. Gerrard's insights aim to support Pochettino in effectively managing the team's dynamics and maximizing Fernandes' contributions to the squad.

health.title: U.S. Expected to Lose Measles
health.summary: The United States is anticipated to lose its measles elimination status after 26 years, with the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) set to make an official announcement on November 17. In 2026, U.S. measles cases reached 5,412, marking the highest total in 35 years, highlighting concerns about vaccination rates and public health measures.

health.title: This time, the virus is on the patient's side. AI helped design it
health.summary: AI has been utilized to create a novel virus, showcasing its capabilities beyond traditional tasks like writing emails or developing recipes. This development follows various creative uses of AI, including a baker who used ChatGPT to design an unconventional cake. The emergence of this AI-generated virus has sparked interest, though it is not considered a cause for alarm.

health.title: World Diabetes Day - Can Type 2 Diabetes Be Reversed? Why Acting Early Matters.
health.summary: On World Diabetes Day, experts discuss the potential for reversing Type 2 diabetes, emphasizing the importance of early intervention. Traditionally, patients have been prepared for a lifelong condition, following a predictable treatment path involving diet, exercise, and medication adjustments. Recent insights suggest that proactive measures may alter this trajectory, highlighting the need for timely action in managing the disease.

science.title: Garnet Supercomputer Gets $334M; Unnamed Blackwell Chips Differ 31-Fold in Double-Precision Speed
science.summary: The Garnet supercomputer, a $334 million Nvidia Blackwell system, is set to be deployed at NCSA in Urbana-Champaign by mid-2027. Funded by a Schmidt Sciences grant, details on the GPU count and specific chip variant remain undisclosed. Nvidia's B200 chip reportedly achieves approximately 37 teraflops of double-precision (FP64) performance, highlighting significant advancements in processing speed.

science.title: Scientists detect mysterious radio signals from star system 5,000 light-years away; dead star emits pulses every eight minutes while orbiting Sun-like companion in rare cosmic discovery
science.summary: Astronomers have identified a rare star system located over 5,000 light-years away, emitting mysterious radio pulses every eight minutes. This discovery involves a dead star that orbits a Sun-like companion, marking a significant finding in cosmic research. The detection of these radio signals adds to the understanding of stellar phenomena and the behaviors of such distant celestial bodies.

science.title: The Leonid meteor shower peaks Nov. 17-18! Here's what you need to know
science.summary: The Leonid meteor shower will peak overnight on November 17-18, with observers able to see up to 15 meteors per hour. This event features bright fireballs and Earth-grazers as Earth passes through debris from Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle. Ideal viewing conditions require a dark sky for optimal meteor visibility during this annual astronomical phenomenon.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 17, 2026

This period may challenge their sense of stability in worldly affairs. However, maintaining self-confidence and guiding oneself through these uncertainties is encouraged. Embracing personal strength can help navigate this phase, leading to potential growth and clarity in various life areas.

entertainment.title: Scorpio Horoscope Today: November 17, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 17, 2026, Scorpios are advised to be cautious about sharing their time, energy, and resources. While many may seek their attention, it is crucial for Scorpios to discern who is genuinely deserving of their efforts. The day emphasizes the importance of being selective in relationships and interactions, ensuring that their contributions are valued appropriately.

entertainment.summary: On November 17, 2026, Capricorns may experience conflicting feelings. It is advised to approach these challenges methodically, akin to the game of Mikado, by addressing one issue at a time. This strategy will help Capricorns regain a sense of control and stability in their lives. Patience and careful consideration are key to navigating the current complexities.
